edbDesc: A force acting on a rotating body in space caused by the anisotropic emission of thermal photons, which carry momentum. It is usually considered in relation to meteoroids or small asteroids (about 10 cm to 10 km in diameter), as its influence is most significant for these bodies.
title: Yarkovsky Effect
pickWhy: A thrust from heat radiation that only matters to small asteroids over millions of years, far too weak to do a job at a useful size.
